description: Regression probe: Conda resolver must NOT classify a non-Conda environment.yaml as a Conda manifest (TKA-10917). The file application/src/main/resources/environment.yaml is a Hippo CMS/JCR config with no conda schema keys (name/channels/dependencies). Expected: 0 Conda deps. Any Conda dep detected = regression.

dependency_tree._comment_total_dependencies: Maven pom.xml contributes 2 direct deps (commons-lang3, guava) plus transitives. Conda must contribute EXACTLY 0.
dependency_tree._comment_conda_dependency_count: STRICT zero: any non-zero value here means the Conda resolver incorrectly processed the non-Conda environment.yaml. This is the primary regression signal for TKA-10917.

package_managers._comment_package_managers: maven must be detected (pom.xml present). conda must NOT appear as a contributing PM.

dependency_tree._comment_package_managers_conda_absent: If 'conda' appears in the actual package_managers list alongside Maven, the resolver is misclassifying the Hippo CMS environment.yaml — TKA-10917 regression confirmed.

logs._comment_must_not_contain: The scanner log must NOT contain the Conda manifest classification line for the non-Conda YAML path. If present, filename-only manifest detection is still active.

must_not_contain._comment: This log line is the exact signal from TKA-10917. Its presence means the Conda resolver still routes non-Conda YAMLs by filename alone.
Conda emits this when it receives a non-Conda YAML. If the scanner reaches this point it has already mis-classified the file.
The Conda resolver must not be invoked at all for this repo. Any tree-size log from CondaDependencyResolver is a regression.
